name: PCC Network Tools
description: Tool definitions for the Physical Capability Cloud. Feed these to your AI agent so it can discover capabilities, build contracts, monitor jobs, and manage escrow on the PCC network.

tools.name: list_capability_types
tools.description: List all capability types available on the PCC network (e.g. FDM, SLA, CNC, HPLC).

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Search for capability templates by type or keyword. Returns matching capability templates with pricing info.

tools.name: get_build_options
tools.description: Get available configuration options for a capability type (materials, dimensions, tolerances, etc).

tools.name: calculate_price
tools.description: Calculate price for a capability configuration. Returns pricing breakdown.

tools.name: build_contract
tools.description: Build and submit a capability contract with the given parameters and assurance tier.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List all jobs (active and completed) with their status.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific job including progress and evidence.

tools.name: list_kernels
tools.description: List all Shop Kernels (physical manufacturing sites) with their status and capabilities.

tools.name: get_kernel
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Shop Kernel including devices and queue.

tools.name: list_escrows
tools.description: List all escrow contracts with milestone status and bond information.

tools.name: get_escrow
tools.description: Get detailed escrow information including milestones, bonds, and challenge windows.

tools.name: get_marketplace_overview
tools.description: Get equipment marketplace overview with demand/supply metrics.

tools.name: get_operator_dashboard
tools.description: Get operator dashboard data (machines, earnings, maintenance).

tools.name: get_sensor_data
tools.description: Get sensor readings for a specific kernel.

tools.name: list_batches
tools.description: List all active and completed batches.

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.description: List encrypted evidence bundles with verification status.

tools.name: get_logistics_overview
tools.description: Get logistics hub overview (shipments, installations, bookings).

tools.name: list_protocols
tools.description: List available protocol templates in the library.

tools.name: get_protocol
tools.description: Get a specific protocol template with DAG definition and parameters.

tools.name: get_orchestrator_status
tools.description: Get orchestrator overview (transfer graph, resource pools, active workflows).

tools.name: get_onboard_options
tools.description: Get onboarding options for registering a new machine on the network.

tools.name: search_spaces
tools.description: Search for available lab/workshop spaces with filters.

tools.name: get_depin_stats
tools.description: Get DePIN statistics (treasury, certificates, reward epochs).

tools.name: get_subnet_status
tools.description: Get Bittensor verification subnet status (health, miner leaderboard).

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List recent agent-to-agent conversations on the network.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate the user to a specific dashboard page.

tools.name: check_wallet_status
tools.description: Check if the user has a wallet connected.
